name: Current look
reference: what the kit renders today (stylized realism)
note: Textured PBR, soft sun, no lines. The control tile.

name: Ink & flat color
note: Flat fills, hard two-tone shade, bold ink lines, stipple, pastel sky. Textures carry no detail.

name: Painted stylized
note: Hand-painted texture detail, saturated, warm key + cool fill, rim light, soft bloom. No lines.

name: Cel toon, colored lines
note: Three-step shade ramp, hard specular shapes, outlines in a darker fill color, flat sky.

name: Gouache storybook
note: Soft washes, wet edges, paper grain, pencil underdrawing, washed shadows. Everything fades to paper.

name: Comic halftone
note: Flat posterized color, Ben-Day dots in the shade, thick black inks, slight misregistration.

name: Flat-shaded graphic
note: No textures: one color per surface, faceted lighting, long cool shadows, big gradient sky with a sun.

name: Oil-painted realism
note: Brush strokes that follow the forms over the real textures, teal/orange grade, painterly sky.

name: Pen & ink crosshatch
reference: ink drawing with a tinted wash
note: Sketchy outlines, three layers of hatching in the shade, cream paper, a light color wash.
